# Pre-registration erratum 2

Erratum 2 (25 Oct 2026). The old name of the working folder was replaced by the current one ("avg") in three lines of two frozen files: the CI's temporary-folder prefix and the docstring that names it (`ci/run.py`), and a comment (`harness/adapters/agy.py`). The old name was the event's; the experiment is the author's own work, not tied to any employer or event. Nothing in the plan, the questions, the measures or the analysis changed: the CI checks, their order and their verdicts are the same; only the name of a temporary folder differs.

- `ci/run.py`, lines 14, 63: original sha256 ca4bd747aec3fba5117af92d21d421d1646768097d7ba3008027055f5a5517f5 · new sha256 b70bef5610de622458c0b178b5276d8460034db4d21a8e8a55e095b3e6dd7e8e
- `harness/adapters/agy.py`, line 12: original sha256 371d9d4c67cb8f5c6a2131ef13c65114d9d825340cc3d086b95159d7ee5cb747 · new sha256 53b569de73165d22341971ecd6e26504de8e1caf2448f6cd38836d5f618b1848

It then prints "verified with erratum 2".
